content.text: In Kenya, where the dominance of platforms like Stripe and PayPal restricts your ability to sell ebooks, infrastructure sovereignty offers a liberating solution. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-explained-digital|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-store-cloudflare-pages-free-works-8|deploying]] a custom-built commerce stack, you can bypass these restrictions, collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-what-nobody-tells-2|Payment Infrastructure]]s directly from your customers, and maintain full control over your data. The infrastructure problem is clear: in Kenya, where the lack of access to global payment gateways hinders ebook sales, a sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a reliable, low-cost alternative. This guide will walk you through the steps to deploy such an infrastructure, ensuring you can sell ebooks freely, without relying on platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Ebooks kenya

This infrastructure works because it's built on a decentralized architecture, leveraging the power of blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare's global network. By utilizing NOWPayments, a payment processor that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare, you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This setup allows you to bypass the traditional payment processor restrictions, giving you the freedom to sell ebooks directly to your customers, without intermediaries.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a few essential tools: the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide; a Cloudflare account; a NOWPayments account; and a basic understanding of how to set up a Cloudflare Workers script. You'll also need to have your ebook ready for sale, packaged in a format that can be easily delivered to customers. With these tools in place, you'll be ready to deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure and start selling ebooks freely.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your Cloudflare Workers script to work with NOWPayments. This involves integrating your NOWPayments account with your Cloudflare account, creating a payment notification endpoint, and setting up a delivery script that will send your ebook to customers upon payment confirmation. You'll also need to configure your Cloudflare account to use a suitable payment method, such as Binance P2P, which supports Kenyan shillings. Once this is set up, you'll be ready to test your payment and delivery pipeline, ensuring that everything works smoothly and efficiently.
This infrastructure offers a liberating solution to the problem of platform dominance, allowing you to collect payments directly from your customers and maintain full control over your data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, simply deploy your Cloudflare Workers script, configure your NOWPayments account, and set up your delivery script. Once everything is in place, you can test your payment and delivery pipeline by processing a payment using a test payment method. This will ensure that the entire process works smoothly, from payment confirmation to ebook delivery. With this infrastructure, you can start selling ebooks directly to your customers, without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, scaling is relatively straightforward. Simply upgrade your Cloudflare account to a higher plan, if necessary, and configure your NOWPayments account to handle increased traffic. You may also need to optimize your Cloudflare Workers script to improve performance and reduce latency. Additionally, you can use the Sovereign Blueprint's scaling playbook to guide you through the process of scaling your infrastructure, ensuring that you have the resources and expertise you need to support your growing business.
Where can I sell my eBook in Kenya?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
By leveraging blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare's global network, you can bypass traditional payment processor restrictions and start selling ebooks freely.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to sell ebooks from Kenya, you may also want to check out The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. Additionally, you can visit our product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our other products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
